acceptanceCriteria: A diagnosis on each missed case's base commit names the slot or limit that dropped the documentation or non-Go file, recorded in a build-log entry.

Without a subject, lexical documentation and non-Go matches compete with source rows by match strength rather than being cut by source-first ordering, or the packet states the omitted class as uncertainty.
The frozen retrieval evaluations do not regress, and the fix is validated on a held-out repository whose cases were frozen before the fix ran against it.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

V1-0019 rc.2 runs (1.0.0-rc.2; build-log docs/build-log/2026-10-06-v1-0019-rc2-runs.md): UC-TASK-ORIENTATION FAILED on urfave/cli run-001, Corvint run-002 and beamfall/core run-002 while consequence and completion passed. The rc.1 test-file miss class (V1-0431) no longer dominates. Treatment-only critical misses are now documentation and non-Go files the git-grep control admitted: urfave docs/v3/examples/flags/advanced.md and godoc snapshot files (plus flag_impl.go, flag_bool_with_inverse.go), and Corvint README.md, ROADMAP.md, docs/DOGFOOD.md, three specs and tools/retrieval-bench files. Distinct from V1-0319 (Beamfall paired trial) and V1-0179 (query ranking).

completion.reason: Delivered in batch I, PR beamfall/corvint#691, auto-merged to main 2026-10-08T21:12:59Z as c8734be3614d30c036b5b7d86d887816aeb5be0e. All 15 hosted CI checks passed on head b6f3eb78. The batch CEM was bound, checked and sealed (commit 1e15a6f1), and Codex reviewed each lane and the integration. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-08-v1-0431-0859-orientation-ranking.md and docs/build-log/2026-10-08-batch-i-integration.md at that commit (each digest is that file’s sha256); the build logs record the focused tests and limits. Delivery stays experimental. NOT_RUN: make gate (owner preference for scoped work).
